name: Curated Colors example
description: Ships an example color palette and a Single Directory Component that demonstrates using a curated color as a CSS class — including via Drupal Canvas.
project_description: Example submodule of Curated Colors. On install it ships a Drupal Brand palette (curated_color_palette drupal_brand: Drupal's official brand colors and gradients, grouped Primary/Secondary/Tertiary/Gradient) and a colored_card Single Directory Component that demonstrates the recommended pattern: the component's color prop is a curated color key applied as a CSS modifier class (colored-card--drupal-blue), so the actual hex/gradient values live only in the component stylesheet, not in content. The colored_card prop is annotated with x-curated-color-palette: drupal_brand so it also gets the swatch picker inside Drupal Canvas's component editor.
